title: The Summer Markus Villig Went Car to Car Recruiting Taxi Drivers
conflicts: The family money: €5,000 from his parents (Villig on Mixergy 2019; CNBC 'family loan'), from his brother and parents (Business Daily Africa 2020), or a developer asking €7,000 with the lent sum unstated (Invest in Estonia 2019); story uses his own €5,000 figure. Refusal rate 90% (Mixergy) vs 8 in 10 (Invest in Estonia); story says 'most'. Mixergy has him saying the loan was in 2014; all other evidence puts it in 2013. His claim of an early shift to private drivers conflicts with Postimees (July 2014) reporting Taxify still worked through taxi companies; left out.
notes: Martin Villig (idea, later full-time co-founder) is named in the story; the founder field keeps Markus, whose decision the episode is. Tagore's Sadhana was written in English, so no translator is given.
